description:
For FREE consultation regarding your health or term insurance needs, book a 30-min call in your preferred language - https://ditto.sh/rovtun

In this video, we break down the Aditya Birla Activ One Max vs HDFC Ergo Optima Secure vs Care Supreme plans in detail — comparing everything from insurer performance metrics, waiting periods, room rent rules, restoration benefits, bonus structures, and add-ons, to how much you’ll actually pay in premiums for different profiles. If you’ve been thinking about upgrading your health cover or buying a new policy, this is your one-stop guide to making an informed choice.

Let’s start with the insurers themselves. HDFC Ergo leads the pack with the highest Claim Settlement Ratio and lowest complaint volume, backed by a massive network of over 12,000 hospitals. Aditya Birla sits close behind with strong CSR and solid service metrics. Care has a decent CSR and one of the largest hospital networks in the country, but its complaint numbers are slightly higher. This matters because a good plan on paper is only as good as the insurer’s track record in actually paying claims on time.

HDFC Ergo Optima Secure is one of the most comprehensive retail health policies in the market. No room rent or co-pay clauses, reasonable 3-year waiting period for pre-existing diseases, AYUSH and domiciliary cover included, and industry-first features like the Secure Benefit (instant double cover), Protect Benefit (covers consumables at no extra cost), and Plus Benefit (50% bonus every year irrespective of claims). Over 2 renewals, your cover can grow to 3X the base — and with optional unlimited restoration, it’s hard to beat. The downside? It’s usually pricier than the competition, and there’s no add-on to reduce PED waiting periods.

Care Supreme, on the other hand, is all about aggressive pricing. It offers unlimited automatic restoration from the first claim, a generous bonus structure that can grow your cover up to 7X over 5 renewals (with add-ons), and the option to slash the standard 4-year waiting period to as low as 30 days for select conditions like diabetes, asthma, and hypertension. The trade-offs? Higher complaint volumes compared to HDFC, and the need to buy add-ons to match some of the in-built benefits you’d get elsewhere.

Then there’s Aditya Birla Activ One Max — a rising star in this category. No room rent or co-pay clauses, unlimited restoration via Super Reload, in-built consumables coverage, and a very generous Super Credit bonus that doubles your sum insured every year until it reaches 500% of the base. Add the Health Returns program (up to 100% renewal premium discount for healthy living) and you’ve got a plan that rewards wellness while offering serious long-term coverage growth. The main consideration? Aditya Birla is newer in the retail health space compared to HDFC or Care, so there’s less long-term claims data available.

Midway takeaway — if post-sales support and proven claim handling are top priorities, HDFC Ergo still leads. If you’re looking for aggressive pricing and flexible waiting period reduction, Care Supreme is compelling. If you want massive bonus growth and wellness-linked rewards, Aditya Birla Activ One Max is worth serious consideration.

Bottom line — all three are strong plans, but the “best” one depends on your personal priorities. This video will walk you through each plan’s strengths, limitations, and ideal buyer profile so you can make a confident, data-backed choice.
